That was a dress rehearsal for the Rangers, who had a lot of veterans in the lineup against an Islanders squad that was made up mostly of youngsters who will be in the AHL.</p><p>The Blueshirts came away with a dominant 6-1 victory, with the most important takeaway for the orange and blue being goalie <a data-ylk="slk:Semyon Varlamov;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"Semyon Varlamov","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yHasCommerce":false}" href="https://www.si.com/nhl/islanders/onsi/news/semyon-varlamov-survives-ny-rangers-crushing-ny-islanders" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">Semyon Varlamov</a> and defensemen <a data-ylk="slk:Alexander Romanov and Ryan Pulock;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"Alexander Romanov and Ryan Pulock","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yHasCommerce":false}" href="https://www.si.com/nhl/islanders/onsi/news/ny-islanders-defensive-duo-has-successful-returns-to-ice" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">Alexander Romanov and Ryan Pulock</a> all making successful returns from injury.</p><p>Romanov and Pulock are both back in the lineup for the finale against the Devils as two of the seven defensemen who are in the lineup. More NHL regulars will be featured, but not <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/33423/" rel="">Matthew Schaefer</a>, who is getting another night off. The rest of the blue line lineup is <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/5756/" rel="">Adam Pelech</a>, <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/8788/" rel="">Matt Kessel</a>, <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/5402/" rel="">Scott Mayfield</a>, <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/9366/" rel="">Isaiah George</a> and <a data-ylk="slk:Kashawn Aitcheson;elm:context_link;itc:0;sec:content-canvas;" data-yga="{"yLinkText":"Kashawn Aitcheson","yLinkElement":"context_link","yModuleName":"content-canvas","yHasCommerce":false}" href="https://www.si.com/nhl/islanders/onsi/news/ny-islanders-kashawn-aitcheson-might-be-ready-to-help-in-nhl-sooner-than-expected" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">Kashawn Aitcheson</a>.</p><h2 class="heading">Islanders announce lineup for final preseason game</h2><figure class="content-figure"><div class="content-image"><img alt="New York Rangers right wing Eeli Tolvanen (17) and New York Islanders defenseman Kashawn Aitcheson (37) battle for puck." fetchPriority="high" loading="eager" width="912" height="513" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="standard-img" style="color:transparent" src="https://s.yimg.com/lo/mysterio/api/0751d77224660fca46ea9627cbe1e55fc359afe7d511a4c5fced715e90a40b4a/lightyear_networkapi/resizefill_w912_h513%3Bquality_80%3Bformat_webp/https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.zenfs.com%2Fen%2Fnew_york_islanders_on_si_463%2F68c42f420eded4a78b42f3f26f504f39.jpg"/></div><figcaption class="fig-caption"><div style="max-height:none;overflow:visible"><span class="[&_p]:inline"><p>Sep 22, 2026; New York, New York, USA; New York Rangers right wing Eeli Tolvanen (17) and New York Islanders defenseman Kashawn Aitcheson (37) battle for control of the puck in the second period at Madison Square Garden. Mandatory Credit: Wendell Cruz-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect</p></span></div></figcaption></figure><p>Varlamov is getting the night off. It will be <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/6408/" rel="">Vitek Vanecek</a> as the No. 2 behind <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/6447/" rel="">Ilya Sorokin</a>, who is expected to start and play the entirety of the game to prepare himself for the season opener, which is scheduled for Sept. 30 on the road against the <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/teams/toronto/" rel="">Toronto Maple Leafs</a>.</p><p>Up front, <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/teams/ny-islanders/" rel="">New York</a> is going with 11 forwards tonight against <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/teams/new-jersey/" rel="">New Jersey</a>. <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/6060/" rel="">Anthony Duclair</a> is suiting up for a second straight game along with <a data-ylk="" data-yga="{"yHasCommerce":false}" href="/nhl/players/8683/" rel="">Emil Heineman</a>.
